changeLog: Added role-aware visibility and a failed-read state to the web dashboard. The Business Owner and dashboard layout requirements retain their existing scope and status.

requirements.requirement: Hide dashboard KPI cards, their definitions and operations metrics when the current account lacks access to their source module.
requirements.scope: Web dashboard KPI cards and Operations Overview
requirements.uiReference: Finance dashboard screenshot showing Active customers, Active deliveries and Drivers on delivery as unavailable
requirements.dataSource: The admin.dashboard response and its allowed module list from navigationAccess
requirements.securityControl: Existing server-side branch and module authorisation. The API omits restricted values and the UI uses the current permissions returned by the server.
negativeTests: Finance receives null customer and delivery metrics despite a real order in its branch
Restricted metrics and the Active customers definition are absent in the Finance dashboard
requirements.reason: Finance shows permitted records at desktop and mobile widths. The owner sees the real Active customers count and its link.
requirements.testResult: PASS · local authenticated Chromium and backend scoping tests

requirements.requirement: Distinguish a confirmed zero from a failed read for permitted dashboard KPIs and provide a clear retry instruction.
requirements.scope: Web dashboard KPI state and refresh
requirements.dataSource: Authorised admin.dashboard totals and widget error results
requirements.securityControl: Refresh rereads the scoped server response using the authenticated account.
negativeTests: Falling back to a fabricated zero on a failed permitted read
A single failed widget discarding healthy results
requirements.reason: A permitted zero displays as zero. An isolated failure shows a compact message and a successful refresh restores the actual count.
requirements.testResult: PASS · dashboard regressions and local Chromium zero, failure and retry checks

gates.requirement: Restricted Finance widgets are omitted and authorised owner metrics remain accessible.
An authorised zero, failed read and successful retry have distinct states.
